_comment: SimpleReconDorking run-config preset. Copy this file, edit as needed, and pass with --config.
_note: Keys set to null are ignored (CLI/argparse defaults apply). CLI flags always override config values.
_proxy_note: proxy accepts a single string or a list; proxy_file adds a file on top of it.
_tor_note: tor_proxy is used ONLY by the darkweb sources (ahmia, torch, tor66, tordex); keep the socks5h scheme so Tor resolves .onion.
_no_tor_note: true skips those same four sources entirely - for machines with no Tor daemon, where they would only fail. onionsearch and tor66web are NOT skipped: they reach .onion over clearnet.
_verbose_note: 1 is the tool default (per-source hit counts). 0 = counters only; 4 = full debug. A run-config value only applies when the CLI did not pass -v.
